body:
Well I was sitting home alone one day and didnt have any money to go out and buy weed but I still wanted a buzz.  I looked around the house and found one cigarette.  I thought 'what the hell, lets see what all the fuss is about these things'.  I went outside and lit up.  I noticed that the smoke from this thing was 100 times harsher than from weed.  I took like 4 hits and felt really light headed, and sorta good.  I though 'hey this feels kinda good'.  I finished of the whole cigarette and went back inside.  As I was walking to the place were I got the lighter from I started feeling very very nauseous.  It was one of the worst feelings I got in my entire life.  I though that if I sat down and relaxed it would go away. I was wrong.  The feeling only intensified to the point were I was in so much pain I didn't know what to do.  I got up and ran to the washroom were I vomited for over 10 minutes.  I was so disoriented and thought I was seriously going to pass out while throwing up.  I will never touch another tobacco cigarette in my life.  This experience was awful!
